But there is NO optimistic concurrency: no version column, no updated_at compare-and-swap, and the wizard posts its ENTIRE in-memory responses map on every back/next navigation and on submit (app/intake/[token]/IntakeWizard.tsx:113-117, 134-138, 150). Two tabs/devices on the same link (P1-03 makes multiple live links likely — every resend/reminder mints another) each hold full stale maps; every save silently overwrites the row's newer values key-by-key with the sender's stale values. A stale offline client that reconnects and saves reverts newer answers with no error, no conflict signal, no audit.
